name: Soul-Ripper
disable: DC 33 Diplomacy check or DC 33 Deception check to convince the spirits to ignore you, or DC 30 Occultism check or DC 30 Religion check to weaken the haunt; four successes are required to disable it. After 5 rounds, Oourax's soul is sundered and the haunt ends.
routine: (1 action) Oourax's soul attempts to flee, moving 20 feet in a random direction. Her soul is pursued by two hosts of devilish spirits. Large or smaller creatures (or troops composed of Large or smaller creatures) within a 20-foot emanation of Oourax's soul are trampled by the spirits (2d10+13 spirit damage with a DC 28 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Devil's Due
items.text:
Trigger Oourax dies

---
Effect Oourax's soul rises from her body. The haunt rolls initiative.

text: Two hosts of shadowy spirits emerge from Hell to rip Oourax's soul in two, damaging all those who stand in their path.
